phoenix-park-peoples-flower-gardens.en_description: A 9-hectare Victorian flower garden inside Phoenix Park, with an ornamental lake, playground and seasonal flower beds.

phoenix-park-visitor-centre-ashtown-cast.pt_source: Centro de visitantes do Phoenix Park ao lado do Castelo de Ashtown, uma casa-torre redescoberta, com jardim murado vitoriano e exposições.
phoenix-park-visitor-centre-ashtown-cast.pt_title: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre, Ashtown Castle and Biodiversity Centre
phoenix-park-visitor-centre-ashtown-cast.en_description: The Phoenix Park visitor centre beside Ashtown Castle, a rediscovered tower house, with a Victorian walled garden and exhibitions.

pearse-museum-st-endas-park.pt_source: Museu na casa onde Patrick Pearse viveu e dirigiu a sua escola de ensino em irlandês entre 1910 e 1916, num parque de cerca de 20 hectares.
pearse-museum-st-endas-park.en_description: A museum in the house where Patrick Pearse lived and ran his Irish-speaking school between 1910 and 1916, set in a park of about 20 hectares.

iveagh-gardens.pt_source: Conhecidos como o “jardim secreto” de Dublin, com labirinto de teixos, rosário, fontes e cascata, desenhados por Ninian Niven em 1865.
iveagh-gardens.en_description: Known as Dublin's "secret garden", with a yew maze, rosery, fountains and cascade, designed by Ninian Niven in 1865.

irish-national-war-memorial-gardens.pt_source: Jardins memoriais em Islandbridge, dedicados aos 49.400 soldados irlandeses mortos na Primeira Guerra Mundial, desenhados por Sir Edwin Lutyens.
irish-national-war-memorial-gardens.en_description: Memorial gardens at Islandbridge, dedicated to the 49,400 Irish soldiers who died in the First World War, designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens.

grangegorman-military-cemetery.pt_source: O maior cemitério militar da Irlanda, aberto em 1876 para pessoal do Império Britânico, com túmulos das duas guerras mundiais.
grangegorman-military-cemetery.en_description: Ireland's largest military cemetery, opened in 1876 for British Empire personnel, with graves from both world wars.

government-buildings.pt_source: Sede de departamentos do Estado irlandês e o último grande edifício público construído pelos britânicos na Irlanda, com visitas guiadas gratuitas aos sábados.
government-buildings.en_description: The seat of Irish government departments and the last major public building constructed by the British in Ireland, with free guided tours on Saturdays.

garden-of-remembrance.pt_source: Jardim memorial no centro de Dublin, dedicado a todos os que deram a vida pela liberdade irlandesa, com a escultura dos Filhos de Lir.
garden-of-remembrance.en_description: A memorial garden in central Dublin, dedicated to all those who gave their lives for Irish freedom, with the Children of Lir sculpture.

farmleigh-house-and-estate.pt_source: Propriedade eduardiana de 78 acres dentro do Phoenix Park, usada como residência oficial de hóspedes do Estado, com jardins e parque abertos ao público.
farmleigh-house-and-estate.en_description: A 78-acre Edwardian estate inside Phoenix Park, used as the State's official guest residence, with gardens and parkland open to the public.

custom-house-visitor-centre.pt_source: Centro de visitantes dedicado à história do edifício da Alfândega de Dublin, da autoria de James Gandon, e a mais de 230 anos de história irlandesa.
custom-house-visitor-centre.en_description: A visitor centre dedicated to the history of Dublin's Custom House, designed by James Gandon, and to more than 230 years of Irish history.

casino-marino.pt_source: Pequeno templo de jardim neoclássico do século XVIII, com 16 salas decoradas, considerado uma obra-prima da arquitetura europeia.
casino-marino.en_description: A small 18th-century neoclassical garden temple, with 16 decorated rooms, considered a masterpiece of European architecture.

arbour-hill-cemetery.pt_source: Cemitério militar onde estão sepultados 14 dos líderes executados do Levante da Páscoa de 1916.
arbour-hill-cemetery.en_description: A military cemetery where 14 of the executed leaders of the 1916 Easter Rising are buried.

fota-arboretum-and-gardens.pt_source: Arboreto de 11 hectares na Ilha de Fota com uma das melhores coleções da Europa de árvores e arbustos raros ao ar livre.
fota-arboretum-and-gardens.en_description: An 11-hectare arboretum on Fota Island with one of Europe's finest outdoor collections of rare trees and shrubs.

desmond-castle-kinsale.pt_source: Casa-torre urbana do início do século XVI no centro de Kinsale, que foi alfândega, prisão e armazém ao longo da sua história.
desmond-castle-kinsale.en_description: An urban tower house from the early 16th century in the centre of Kinsale, which over its history served as custom house, prison and warehouse.

barryscourt-castle.pt_source: Um dos melhores exemplos de casa-torre irlandesa, construído entre 1392 e 1420, com salões restaurados e jardim de ervas.
barryscourt-castle.en_description: One of the finest examples of an Irish tower house, built between 1392 and 1420, with restored halls and a herb garden.

annes-grove-gardens.pt_source: Antiga propriedade da família Annesley no norte de Cork, com jardins paisagísticos de estilo Robinsoniano e uma coleção rara de arbustos floridos.
annes-grove-gardens.en_description: A former Annesley family estate in north Cork, with Robinsonian-style landscaped gardens and a rare collection of flowering shrubs.

national-design-craft-gallery.pt_source: Única galeria da Irlanda dedicada exclusivamente a design e artesanato, no Castle Yard do século XVIII, ao lado do Kilkenny Castle.
national-design-craft-gallery.en_description: Ireland's only gallery dedicated exclusively to design and craft, in the 18th-century Castle Yard, beside Kilkenny Castle.

cavan-cathedral.pt_source: Catedral católica de Cavan, dedicada a São Patrício e São Félim, construída na década de 1940 e notável pelo interior com vitrais.
cavan-cathedral.en_description: Cavan's Catholic cathedral, dedicated to St Patrick and St Felim, built in the 1940s and notable for its stained-glass interior.

jfk-arboretum.pt_source: Arboreto de 623 acres perto de New Ross, dedicado a John F. Kennedy, com mais de 5.000 tipos de árvores e mirante no Slieve Coillte.
jfk-arboretum.en_description: A 623-acre arboretum near New Ross, dedicated to John F. Kennedy, with more than 5,000 varieties of trees and a lookout point on Slieve Coillte.

lough-muckno-leisure-park.pt_source: Parque lacustre municipal em Castleblayney, com trilhas, parque infantil, pesca e desportos aquáticos, aberto todo o ano.
lough-muckno-leisure-park.en_description: A municipal lakeside park in Castleblayney, with walking trails, a playground, fishing and water sports, open all year round.

old-head-of-kinsale.pt_source: Ponta rochosa cênica perto de Kinsale, com farol, signal tower e memorial do Lusitania; o percurso exterior e o mirante são de acesso livre.
old-head-of-kinsale.en_description: A scenic rocky headland near Kinsale, with a lighthouse, signal tower and Lusitania memorial; the outer walk and lookout are freely accessible.

dursey-island.pt_source: Ilha habitada no fim da península de Beara, alcançada pelo único teleférico da Irlanda, com trilhas costeiras e colônias de aves marinhas.
dursey-island.en_description: An inhabited island at the end of the Beara Peninsula, reached by Ireland's only cable car, with coastal trails and seabird colonies.

doagh-famine-village.pt_source: Museu a céu aberto na península de Inishowen que conta a história de uma família de Donegal da Grande Fome até os dias atuais.
doagh-famine-village.en_description: An open-air museum on the Inishowen Peninsula telling the story of a Donegal family from the Great Famine to the present day.

the-model.pt_source: Galeria de arte de Sligo e sede da Niland Collection, com importantes obras de Jack B. Yeats e entrada gratuita às galerias.
the-model.en_description: Sligo's art gallery and home of the Niland Collection, with important works by Jack B. Yeats and free admission to the galleries.

joyce-tower-museum.pt_source: Torre Martello de 1804 onde começa o Ulysses, hoje museu gratuito com coleção joyceana e vista para a baía de Dublin.
joyce-tower-museum.en_description: An 1804 Martello tower where Ulysses opens, today a free museum with a Joycean collection and views over Dublin Bay.

derrigimlagh.pt_source: Turfeira de Connemara com dois marcos do século XX: as ruínas da estação de rádio transatlântica de Marconi e o memorial da travessia de Alcock e Brown.
derrigimlagh.en_description: A Connemara bogland with two 20th-century landmarks: the ruins of Marconi's transatlantic radio station and the memorial to Alcock and Brown's crossing.

forty-foot.pt_source: Ponto histórico de banho de mar em Sandycove, no extremo sul da baía de Dublin, com tradição de natação o ano inteiro.
forty-foot.en_description: A historic sea-bathing spot at Sandycove, at the southern tip of Dublin Bay, with a year-round swimming tradition.

chester-beatty.pt_source: Museu de culturas do mundo dentro do Dublin Castle, com entrada gratuita e coleções da Ásia, do Oriente Médio, do Norte da África e da Europa.
chester-beatty.en_description: A museum of world cultures inside Dublin Castle, with free entry and collections from Asia, the Middle East, North Africa and Europe.

king-johns-castle-carlingford.pt_source: Fortaleza normanda do século XII sobre o Carlingford Lough, com salão medieval e vista para as Mourne Mountains.
king-johns-castle-carlingford.en_description: A 12th-century Norman fortress above Carlingford Lough, with a medieval hall and views of the Mourne Mountains.

mount-leinster-nine-stones.pt_source: Ponto mais alto das Blackstairs Mountains (795 m), com mirante dos Nine Stones e vista para quatro condados.
mount-leinster-nine-stones.en_description: The highest point of the Blackstairs Mountains (795 m), with the Nine Stones lookout and views over four counties.

oak-park-forest-park.pt_source: Floresta de carvalhos e faías com trilhas, lagos e o Oak Park Lake, perto da cidade de Carlow.
oak-park-forest-park.en_description: Woodland of oak and beech with trails, lakes and Oak Park Lake, near the town of Carlow.

borris-house.pt_source: Casa ancestral dos MacMurrough Kavanagh, reis de Leinster, com salões Tudor e mercado de artesãos.
borris-house.en_description: The ancestral home of the MacMurrough Kavanaghs, kings of Leinster, with Tudor halls and a craft market.

huntington-castle-gardens.pt_source: Castelo de 1625 da família Durdin-Robertson, com porões medievais, jardins murados e templo druídico.
huntington-castle-gardens.en_description: A 1625 castle of the Durdin-Robertson family, with medieval cellars, walled gardens and a druidic temple.

ducketts-grove.pt_source: Ruínas góticas vitorianas da mansão Duckett, com walled gardens restaurados e parque público.
ducketts-grove.en_description: Victorian Gothic ruins of the Duckett mansion, with restored walled gardens and a public park.

altamont-gardens.pt_source: Jardins românticos do século XVIII com lago, arboreto e o "corredor de azaleias" — entrada gratuita.
altamont-gardens.en_description: Romantic 18th-century gardens with a lake, arboretum and the "azalea walk" — free entry.

brownshill-dolmen.pt_source: Dólmen com a maior laje de cobertura da Europa: 100 toneladas de granito sobre pedras de suporte de 5.000 anos.
brownshill-dolmen.en_description: A dolmen with the largest capstone in Europe: 100 tonnes of granite resting on 5,000-year-old support stones.

millmount-fort-museum.pt_source: Fortaleza sobre motte normanda com vista de Drogheda, abrigando o museu municipal e a torre Martello.
millmount-fort-museum.en_description: A fortress on a Norman motte with views over Drogheda, housing the county museum and the Martello tower.

carlingford-lough-greenway.pt_source: Greenway de 10 km ao longo do lough, entre Carlingford e Newry, com vista para as Mourne Mountains.
carlingford-lough-greenway.en_description: A 10 km greenway along the lough, between Carlingford and Newry, with views of the Mourne Mountains.

mellifont-abbey.pt_source: Primeira abadia cisterciense da Irlanda (1142), com lavabo octogonal único e ruínas evocativas.
mellifont-abbey.en_description: Ireland's first Cistercian abbey (1142), with a unique octagonal lavabo and evocative ruins.

monasterboice.pt_source: Sítio monástico com as alta cruzes mais famosas da Irlanda, incluindo a Muiredach's Cross do século X.
monasterboice.en_description: A monastic site with Ireland's most famous high crosses, including the 10th-century Muiredach's Cross.

proleek-dolmen.pt_source: Dólmen megalítico com laje de 40 toneladas, cercado de lendas — quem acertar uma pedra no topo terá sorte.
proleek-dolmen.en_description: A megalithic dolmen with a 40-tonne capstone, wrapped in legend — whoever lands a stone on top will have good luck.

carlingford.pt_source: Vila medieval preservada na costa do Carlingford Lough, com muralhas, castelo e o Carlingford Oyster Festival.
carlingford.en_description: A preserved medieval village on the shores of Carlingford Lough, with town walls, a castle and the Carlingford Oyster Festival.

mondello-park.pt_source: Único autódromo internacional da Irlanda, com corridas abertas ao público e experiências de pilotagem.
mondello-park.en_description: Ireland's only international racing circuit, with race meetings open to the public and driving experiences.

lullymore-heritage-park.pt_source: Parque de descoberta numa ilha de calcário na turfeira, com tren, playground, minigolfe e história da turfa.
lullymore-heritage-park.en_description: A discovery park on a limestone island in the boglands, with a train ride, playground, mini golf and peatland history.

donadea-forest-park.pt_source: Floresta com trilhas, lago, torre do castelo de Aylmer e o 9/11 Memorial Garden.
donadea-forest-park.en_description: A forest park with trails, a lake, the Aylmer castle tower and the 9/11 Memorial Garden.

maynooth-castle.pt_source: Fortaleza dos Fitzgerald, os poderosos condes de Kildare, no campus da universidade mais antiga da Irlanda.
maynooth-castle.en_description: A Fitzgerald stronghold of the powerful Earls of Kildare, on the campus of Ireland's oldest university.

pollardstown-fen.pt_source: Maior fen (pântano alcalino) da Irlanda, reserva natural com passarelas e plantas raras de origem glacial.
pollardstown-fen.en_description: Ireland's largest fen (alkaline marsh), a nature reserve with boardwalks and rare plants of glacial origin.

bog-of-allen-nature-centre.pt_source: Centro do Irish Peatland Conservation Council com jardim de sapos, turfeira visitável e exposições sobre pântanos.
bog-of-allen-nature-centre.en_description: The Irish Peatland Conservation Council's centre, with a frog garden, a walkable bog and exhibitions about peatlands.

castletown-house.pt_source: Mansão palladiana de 1722, a maior da Irlanda, com salões restaurados e parque aberto ao público.
castletown-house.en_description: A Palladian mansion of 1722, the largest in Ireland, with restored halls and parkland open to the public.

irish-national-stud-japanese-gardens.pt_source: Haras nacional com garanhões campeões, museu do cavalo e os famosos Jardins Japoneses de 1906.
irish-national-stud-japanese-gardens.en_description: The national stud farm with champion stallions, a horse museum and the famous Japanese Gardens of 1906.

curraghchase-forest-park.pt_source: Parque florestal com ruínas da mansão De Vere, trilhas, lago e colônia de morcegos protegida.
curraghchase-forest-park.en_description: A forest park with the ruins of the De Vere mansion, trails, a lake and a protected bat colony.

lough-gur.pt_source: Lago em forma de rim cercado por megálitos, círculos de pedra e o Grange Stone Circle, o maior da Irlanda.
lough-gur.en_description: A kidney-shaped lake surrounded by megaliths, stone circles and the Grange Stone Circle, the largest in Ireland.

foynes-flying-boat-museum.pt_source: Museu na antiga base do Pan Am, com réplica em tamanho real do Boeing 314 e a origem do Irish Coffee.
foynes-flying-boat-museum.en_description: A museum on the former Pan Am base, with a full-size replica Boeing 314 and the origins of Irish Coffee.

adare-village.pt_source: Vila considerada a mais bonita da Irlanda, com cottages de palha, mosteiros e o castelo dos Desmond.
adare-village.en_description: A village considered Ireland's prettiest, with thatched cottages, monasteries and the Desmond castle.

st-marys-cathedral-limerick.pt_source: Catedral de 1168, o edifício em uso mais antigo de Limerick, com misericórdias medievais raras.
st-marys-cathedral-limerick.en_description: A cathedral of 1168, Limerick's oldest building still in use, with rare medieval misericords.

hunt-museum.pt_source: Coleção de arte e antiguidades dos Hunt, com Picasso, Renoir, Leonardo da Vinci e artefatos célticos.
hunt-museum.en_description: The Hunts' collection of art and antiquities, with Picasso, Renoir, Leonardo da Vinci and Celtic artefacts.

king-johns-castle-limerick.pt_source: Castelo normando de 1210 às margens do Shannon, com exposições interativas sobre cercos e história medieval.
king-johns-castle-limerick.en_description: A Norman castle of 1210 on the banks of the Shannon, with interactive exhibitions on sieges and medieval history.

holy-cross-abbey.pt_source: Abadia cisterciense restaurada do século XII, famosa pela relíquia da Vera Cruz e ainda local de culto.
holy-cross-abbey.en_description: A restored 12th-century Cistercian abbey, famous for the relic of the True Cross and still a place of worship.

mitchelstown-cave.pt_source: Uma das maiores cavernas da Europa, com estalactites gigantes, salões enormes e acústica de concertos.
mitchelstown-cave.en_description: One of Europe's largest caves, with giant stalactites, vast chambers and concert-hall acoustics.

ormond-castle.pt_source: Casa isabelina única na Irlanda, construída por Tomás Butler, 10º Conde de Ormond, junto a torres medievais.
ormond-castle.en_description: Ireland's only Elizabethan manor house, built by Thomas Butler, 10th Earl of Ormond, alongside medieval towers.

the-vee-bay-lough.pt_source: Passo de montanha em forma de V com mirante sobre o vale do Suir e o lago glaciar Bay Lough.
the-vee-bay-lough.en_description: A V-shaped mountain pass with a viewpoint over the Suir valley and the glacial lake Bay Lough.

glen-of-aherlow.pt_source: Vale cênico entre as Galtee Mountains, com trilhas, mirante do Christ the King e vilas charmosas.
glen-of-aherlow.en_description: A scenic valley between the Galtee Mountains, with trails, the Christ the King viewpoint and charming villages.

swiss-cottage.pt_source: Chalé ornamental de 1810, exemplo perfeito do estilo "picturesque", com interior restaurado e floresta.
swiss-cottage.en_description: An ornamental cottage of 1810, a perfect example of the "picturesque" style, with a restored interior and woodland.

cahir-castle.pt_source: Um dos castelos mais bem preservados da Irlanda, do século XIII, numa ilha do rio Suir.
cahir-castle.en_description: One of Ireland's best-preserved castles, from the 13th century, on an island in the River Suir.

rock-of-cashel.pt_source: Conjunto medieval espetacular sobre afloramento de calcário: catedral gótica, capela românica e torre redonda.
rock-of-cashel.en_description: A spectacular medieval complex on a limestone outcrop: Gothic cathedral, Romanesque chapel and round tower.

tintern-abbey-wexford.pt_source: Abadia cisterciense fundada em 1200 por William Marshal, com colunata vitoriana e vale arborizado.
tintern-abbey-wexford.en_description: A Cistercian abbey founded in 1200 by William Marshal, with a Victorian colonnade and a wooded valley.

ferns-castle.pt_source: Castelo normando do século XIII com capela em cruz e vitrais modernos, na antiga capital dos reis de Leinster.
ferns-castle.en_description: A 13th-century Norman castle with a cruciform chapel and modern stained glass, in the former capital of the kings of Leinster.

wexford-wildfowl-reserve.pt_source: Reserva natural no North Slob, refúgio de inverno de um terço da população mundial de gansos-de-frente-branca da Groenlândia.
wexford-wildfowl-reserve.en_description: A nature reserve on the North Slob, winter home to one third of the world's Greenland white-fronted geese.

curracloe-beach.pt_source: Praia de 11 km de areia fina, cenário da abertura de "O Resgate do Soldado Ryan", com dunas e trilhas.
curracloe-beach.en_description: An 11 km stretch of fine sandy beach, location of the opening of "Saving Private Ryan", with dunes and trails.

saltee-islands.pt_source: Santuário de aves marinhas com uma das maiores colônias de gansos-patola da Irlanda, acessível por barco de Kilmore Quay.
saltee-islands.en_description: A seabird sanctuary with one of Ireland's largest gannet colonies, reachable by boat from Kilmore Quay.

dunbrody-famine-ship.pt_source: Réplica fiel de um navio de emigrantes da Grande Fome, com tour imersivo sobre a travessia do Atlântico.
dunbrody-famine-ship.en_description: A faithful replica of a Great Famine emigrant ship, with an immersive tour of the Atlantic crossing.

hook-lighthouse.pt_source: Farol medieval em operação desde o século XIII — um dos mais antigos do mundo — com tours e café.
hook-lighthouse.en_description: A medieval lighthouse in operation since the 13th century — one of the oldest in the world — with tours and a café.

johnstown-castle.pt_source: Castelo neogótico do século XIX com lagos, jardins e o Museu da Agricultura Irlandesa.
johnstown-castle.en_description: A 19th-century neo-Gothic castle with lakes, gardens and the Irish Agricultural Museum.

irish-national-heritage-park.pt_source: Parque de 35 acres que recria 9.000 anos de história irlandesa: cabanas do mesolítico, crannóg, mosteiro e anel normando.
irish-national-heritage-park.en_description: A 35-acre park recreating 9,000 years of Irish history: Mesolithic huts, a crannóg, a monastery and a Norman ringwork.

coumshingaun-loop.pt_source: Trilha circular em torno de um lago glaciar num circo de falésias — uma das caminhadas mais espetaculares do sul.
coumshingaun-loop.en_description: A circular trail around a glacial lake in an amphitheatre of cliffs — one of the most spectacular walks in the south.

ardmore-round-tower.pt_source: Sítio monástico de São Declan com torre redonda de 30 m, catedral com esculturas e oratório primitivo.
ardmore-round-tower.en_description: St Declan's monastic site with a 30 m round tower, a carved cathedral and an early oratory.

lismore-castle-gardens.pt_source: Jardins históricos do castelo dos duques de Devonshire, com upper e lower gardens sobre o rio Blackwater.
lismore-castle-gardens.en_description: Historic gardens of the castle of the Dukes of Devonshire, with upper and lower gardens above the River Blackwater.

mount-congreve-gardens.pt_source: Um dos maiores jardins privados da Europa, com 70 acres de azaleias, rododendros e bosques plantados por Ambrose Congreve.
mount-congreve-gardens.en_description: One of Europe's largest private gardens, with 70 acres of azaleas, rhododendrons and woodlands planted by Ambrose Congreve.

copper-coast-geopark.pt_source: Litoral de 25 km com falésias, praias e geologia vulcânica de 460 milhões de anos, patrimônio UNESCO.
copper-coast-geopark.en_description: A 25 km coastline of cliffs, beaches and 460-million-year-old volcanic geology, a UNESCO heritage site.

waterford-greenway.pt_source: Greenway de 46 km sobre antiga ferrovia, com viadutos, túnel e travessia do rio Suir — a mais popular da Irlanda.
waterford-greenway.en_description: A 46 km greenway along a former railway, with viaducts, a tunnel and a crossing of the River Suir — the most popular in Ireland.

reginals-tower.pt_source: Torre viking do século XIII, o edifício civil mais antigo da Irlanda em uso contínuo.
reginals-tower.en_description: A 13th-century Viking tower, Ireland's oldest civic building in continuous use.

waterford-treasures.pt_source: Conjunto de museus sobre a Irlanda viking e medieval, no coração do Viking Triangle.
waterford-treasures.en_description: A group of museums about Viking and medieval Ireland, in the heart of the Viking Triangle.

house-of-waterford-crystal.pt_source: Fábrica e centro de visitantes do cristal Waterford, com tour pela produção e galeria de peças únicas.
house-of-waterford-crystal.en_description: The Waterford Crystal factory and visitor centre, with a tour of the production floor and a gallery of one-of-a-kind pieces.

woodstock-gardens.pt_source: Jardins vitorianos restaurados da mansão Tighe, com arboreto, avenue de teixos e vista do vale do Nore.
woodstock-gardens.en_description: Restored Victorian gardens of the Tighe mansion, with an arboretum, an avenue of yews and views over the Nore valley.

jerpoint-park.pt_source: Cidade medieval perdida de Newtown Jerpoint, com igreja de São Nicolau e lendas sobre o santo.
jerpoint-park.en_description: The lost medieval town of Newtown Jerpoint, with the church of St Nicholas and legends about the saint.

castlecomer-discovery-park.pt_source: Parque de aventura em 80 acres de floresta, com arborismo, zip lines, canoagem e trilhas.
castlecomer-discovery-park.en_description: An adventure park in 80 acres of woodland, with treetop walks, zip lines, canoeing and trails.

dunmore-cave.pt_source: Caverna de calcário com formações dramáticas e história ligada a um ataque viking do século X.
dunmore-cave.en_description: A limestone cave with dramatic formations and a history linked to a 10th-century Viking attack.

smithwicks-experience.pt_source: Tour pela antiga cervejaria de Kilkenny, onde o ale Smithwick's é produzido desde 1710.
smithwicks-experience.en_description: A tour of Kilkenny's former brewery, where Smithwick's ale has been brewed since 1710.

rothe-house-garden.pt_source: Casa mercantil tudor do século XVII, única do tipo aberta ao público na Irlanda, com jardim de recriação histórica.
rothe-house-garden.en_description: A 17th-century Tudor merchant's house, the only one of its kind open to the public in Ireland, with a historically recreated garden.

jerpoint-abbey.pt_source: Abadia cisterciense do século XII com esculturas góticas excepcionais e figuras esculpidas nos túmulos.
jerpoint-abbey.en_description: A 12th-century Cistercian abbey with exceptional Gothic carvings and sculpted figures on its tombs.

medieval-mile-museum.pt_source: Museu na igreja de St Mary sobre a Kilkenny medieval, com cripta e lápidas dos mercadores.
medieval-mile-museum.en_description: A museum in St Mary's Church about medieval Kilkenny, with a crypt and merchants' tombstones.

kilkenny-castle.pt_source: Castelo normando de 1195, sede dos duques de Ormonde por seis séculos, com jardins vitorianos.
kilkenny-castle.en_description: A Norman castle of 1195, seat of the Dukes of Ormonde for six centuries, with Victorian gardens.

clare-island.pt_source: Ilha da pirata Grace O'Malley na entrada de Clew Bay, com abadia muralhada, farol e trilhas costeiras.
clare-island.en_description: Grace O'Malley's pirate island at the mouth of Clew Bay, with a walled abbey, a lighthouse and coastal trails.

wild-nephin-ballycroy-national-park.pt_source: Parque nacional de turfeiras selvagens e montanhas Nephin, com centro de visitantes e céus escuros.
wild-nephin-ballycroy-national-park.en_description: A national park of wild blanket bogs and the Nephin mountains, with a visitor centre and dark skies.

great-western-greenway.pt_source: Greenway de 42 km sobre antiga ferrovia, de Westport a Achill, um dos passeios de bicicleta mais bonitos da Irlanda.
great-western-greenway.en_description: A 42 km greenway along a former railway, from Westport to Achill — one of Ireland's most beautiful cycle rides.

ceide-fields.pt_source: Sistema agrícola neolítico de 5.500 anos, o mais extenso do mundo, sob a turfeira do norte de Mayo.
ceide-fields.en_description: A 5,500-year-old Neolithic field system, the most extensive in the world, beneath the blanket bog of north Mayo.

downpatrick-head.pt_source: Cabeço com o sea stack Dún Briste ("rota quebrada"), igreja antiga e poço de São Patrício sobre o Atlântico.
downpatrick-head.en_description: A headland with the Dún Briste sea stack ("broken track"), an old church and St Patrick's well above the Atlantic.

national-museum-country-life.pt_source: Museu nacional da vida rural irlandesa, num parque com jardins e moinho, entrada gratuita.
national-museum-country-life.pt_title: National Museum of Ireland – Country Life
national-museum-country-life.en_description: The national museum of Irish rural life, in grounds with gardens and a mill — free entry.

westport-house.pt_source: Mansão georgiana da família Browne com parque de aventura, zoológico pequeno e terrenos históricos.
westport-house.en_description: A Georgian mansion of the Browne family with an adventure park, a small zoo and historic grounds.

keem-bay.pt_source: Baía em forma de ferradura com areia branca, eleita repetidamente entre as praias mais bonitas da Irlanda.
keem-bay.en_description: A horseshoe-shaped bay of white sand, repeatedly voted among Ireland's most beautiful beaches.

achill-island.pt_source: Maior ilha da Irlanda, ligada por ponte, com falésias de Croaghaun, praias selvagens e vila de Keel.
achill-island.en_description: Ireland's largest island, linked by a bridge, with the Croaghaun cliffs, wild beaches and the village of Keel.

croagh-patrick.pt_source: Montanha sagrada de São Patrício (764 m), com peregrinação anual e vista sobre Clew Bay e suas 365 ilhotas.
croagh-patrick.en_description: St Patrick's holy mountain (764 m), with an annual pilgrimage and views over Clew Bay and its 365 islands.

eagles-flying.pt_source: Centro irlandês de aves de rapina com demonstrações de voo de águias, falcões e corujas.
eagles-flying.en_description: Ireland's birds-of-prey centre with flying displays of eagles, falcons and owls.

drumcliffe.pt_source: Sítio monástico do século VI com alta cruz e torre redonda, onde está o túmulo de W.B. Yeats.
drumcliffe.en_description: A 6th-century monastic site with a high cross and round tower, where W.B. Yeats is buried.

lissadell-house.pt_source: Mansão dos Gore-Booth, ligada a Constance Markievicz e a Yeats, com jardins e galeria de exposições.
lissadell-house.en_description: The Gore-Booth family mansion, linked to Constance Markievicz and Yeats, with gardens and an exhibition gallery.

sligo-abbey.pt_source: Abadia dominicana do século XIII, única com altar-mor medieval original preservado na Irlanda.
sligo-abbey.en_description: A 13th-century Dominican abbey, the only one in Ireland with its original medieval high altar preserved.

queen-maeves-trail-knocknarea.pt_source: Trilha até o cairn de pedra da rainha Medb no topo do Knocknarea, com vista de Sligo e do Atlântico.
queen-maeves-trail-knocknarea.en_description: A trail up to Queen Medb's cairn of stones on the summit of Knocknarea, with views of Sligo and the Atlantic.

carrowmore-megalithic-cemetery.pt_source: Maior conjunto de túmulos megalíticos da Irlanda, com mais de 5.500 anos, sob o olhar do Knocknarea.
carrowmore-megalithic-cemetery.en_description: Ireland's largest concentration of megalithic tombs, over 5,500 years old, beneath the gaze of Knocknarea.

strandhill-beach.pt_source: Praia de surf aos pés do Knocknarea, com escolas de surf, banhos de sargaço e pôr do sol famoso.
strandhill-beach.en_description: A surfing beach at the foot of Knocknarea, with surf schools, seaweed baths and a famous sunset.

benbulben.pt_source: Mesa de calcário símbolo de Sligo, imortalizada por Yeats, com trilha na crista e caminhada fácil na base.
benbulben.en_description: A limestone table mountain and symbol of Sligo, immortalised by Yeats, with a ridge trail and an easy walk at its base.

ards-forest-park.pt_source: Península florestal com praias, ruínas franciscanas e trilhas costeiras de frente para Sheephaven Bay.
ards-forest-park.en_description: A forested peninsula with beaches, Franciscan ruins and coastal trails facing Sheephaven Bay.

errigal.pt_source: Montanha mais alta de Donegal (751 m), com subida íngreme e panorama sobre o Poisoned Glen.
errigal.en_description: Donegal's highest mountain (751 m), with a steep climb and a panorama over the Poisoned Glen.

grianan-of-aileach.pt_source: Fortaleza de pedra do século VI/VII no topo do Greenan Mountain, antiga sede dos reis de Tyrconnell.
grianan-of-aileach.en_description: A 6th/7th-century stone fort on top of Greenan Mountain, former seat of the kings of Tyrconnell.

fanad-head-lighthouse.pt_source: Farol icônico de 1817 entre as praias de Fanad, com tours internos e hospedagem no farol.
fanad-head-lighthouse.en_description: An iconic 1817 lighthouse among the Fanad beaches, with interior tours and lighthouse accommodation.

malin-head.pt_source: Ponto mais ao norte da Irlanda, com torre de sinais napoleônica, locações de Star Wars e vistas do Atlântico.
malin-head.en_description: Ireland's northernmost point, with a Napoleonic signal tower, Star Wars filming locations and Atlantic views.

donegal-castle.pt_source: Fortaleza dos O'Donnell restaurada com mansão jacobina anexa, no centro de Donegal Town.
donegal-castle.en_description: A restored O'Donnell fortress with an adjoining Jacobean mansion, in the centre of Donegal Town.

sliabh-liag.pt_source: Falésias marinhas de quase 600 metros — entre as mais altas da Europa — com a trilha One Man’s Pass.
sliabh-liag.en_description: Sea cliffs of almost 600 metres — among the highest in Europe — with the One Man's Pass trail.

glenveagh-national-park.pt_source: Segundo maior parque nacional da Irlanda, com castelo, jardins, vales glaciais e águias-reais reintroduzidas.
glenveagh-national-park.en_description: Ireland's second-largest national park, with a castle, gardens, glacial valleys and reintroduced golden eagles.

sliabh-beagh.pt_source: Planalto de turfeira na fronteira com a Irlanda do Norte, com trilhas, mirante e centro de visitantes.
sliabh-beagh.en_description: A bogland plateau on the border with Northern Ireland, with trails, a viewpoint and a visitor centre.

patrick-kavanagh-centre.pt_source: Centro dedicado ao poeta Patrick Kavanagh na igreja antiga de Inniskeen, sua terra natal.
patrick-kavanagh-centre.en_description: A centre dedicated to the poet Patrick Kavanagh in the old church of Inniskeen, his birthplace.

carrickmacross-lace-gallery.pt_source: Ateliê e galeria da famosa renda de Carrickmacross, técnica usada no vestido de noiva de Diana, princesa de Gales.
carrickmacross-lace-gallery.en_description: A studio and gallery of the famous Carrickmacross lace, the technique used in the wedding dress of Diana, Princess of Wales.

monaghan-county-museum.pt_source: Primeiro museu de condado da Irlanda, premiado, com coleções sobre artesanato, conflitos e vida rural.
monaghan-county-museum.en_description: Ireland's first county museum, award-winning, with collections on crafts, conflict and rural life.

rossmore-forest-park.pt_source: Antiga propriedade dos Rossmore com trilhas, esculturas de madeira, lagos e ruínas de portais.
rossmore-forest-park.en_description: A former Rossmore estate with trails, wooden sculptures, lakes and the ruins of old gateways.

castle-leslie-estate.pt_source: Propriedade da família Leslie desde 1660, com castelo vitoriano, centro equestre, lago e trilhas.
castle-leslie-estate.en_description: A Leslie family estate since 1660, with a Victorian castle, an equestrian centre, a lake and trails.

belturbet-railway-station.pt_source: Estação ferroviária de bitola estreita restaurada, com museu ferroviário e vagões de época.
belturbet-railway-station.en_description: A restored narrow-gauge railway station, with a railway museum and period carriages.

cavan-county-museum.pt_source: Museu premiado com a maior réplica de trincheira da Primeira Guerra Mundial ao ar livre na Irlanda.
cavan-county-museum.en_description: An award-winning museum with Ireland's largest outdoor First World War trench replica.

shannon-pot.pt_source: Nascente do rio Shannon, o mais longo da Irlanda, num poço cárstico nas encostas do Cuilcagh.
shannon-pot.en_description: The source of the River Shannon, Ireland's longest river, in a karst pool on the slopes of Cuilcagh.

dun-a-ri-forest-park.pt_source: Parque florestal com cabanas de gelo, ponte romana e lendas locais, nas margens do rio Cabra.
dun-a-ri-forest-park.en_description: A forest park with ice houses, a Roman bridge and local legends, on the banks of the River Cabra.

killykeen-forest-park.pt_source: Penínsulas florestais entre as ilhotas do Lough Oughter, com trilhas, caiaque e pesca.
killykeen-forest-park.en_description: Wooded peninsulas among the islands of Lough Oughter, with trails, kayaking and fishing.

cavan-burren-park.pt_source: Paisagem cárstica com megálitos, dolmens e trilhas interpretativas no Geoparque Global Marble Arch Caves.
cavan-burren-park.en_description: A karst landscape with megaliths, dolmens and interpretive trails in the Marble Arch Caves Global Geopark.

sean-mac-diarmada-cottage.pt_source: Casa natal de um dos signatários da Proclamação de 1916, preservada como museu no norte de Leitrim.
sean-mac-diarmada-cottage.en_description: The birthplace of one of the signatories of the 1916 Proclamation, preserved as a museum in north Leitrim.

lough-rynn-castle-gardens.pt_source: Jardins históricos da propriedade dos Clements, com labirinto, walled garden e vista para o lago.
lough-rynn-castle-gardens.en_description: Historic gardens of the Clements estate, with a maze, a walled garden and views over the lake.

lough-allen.pt_source: Lago serrilhado no alto do Shannon, cercado pelas montanhas de Arigna e Sliabh an Iarainn.
lough-allen.en_description: A jagged lake on the upper Shannon, ringed by the Arigna and Sliabh an Iarainn mountains.

acres-lake-floating-boardwalk.pt_source: Passarela flutuante de 600 m sobre o Lough Allen, parte do Shannon Blueway, com trilhas e caiaque.
acres-lake-floating-boardwalk.en_description: A 600 m floating boardwalk over Lough Allen, part of the Shannon Blueway, with trails and kayaking.

parkes-castle.pt_source: Castelo-forte do século XVII restaurado às margens do Lough Gill, com exposição sobre o plantation.
parkes-castle.en_description: A restored 17th-century fortified castle on the shores of Lough Gill, with an exhibition about the plantation.

glencar-waterfall.pt_source: Cascata de 15 metros imortalizada por W.B. Yeats, perto de Sligo, com trilha curta e área de piquenique.
glencar-waterfall.en_description: A 15-metre waterfall immortalised by W.B. Yeats, near Sligo, with a short trail and a picnic area.

roscommon-castle.pt_source: Castelo normando do século XIII em ruínas evocativas, com parque público e lago ao redor.
roscommon-castle.en_description: A 13th-century Norman castle in evocative ruins, surrounded by a public park and lake.

lough-key-forest-park.pt_source: Parque florestal com ilhas, torre de observação, zip line, bungalows e trilhas para todas as idades.
lough-key-forest-park.en_description: A forest park with islands, an observation tower, a zip line, bungalows and trails for all ages.

arigna-mining-experience.pt_source: Tour guiado por mina de carvão real conduzido por ex-mineradores, nas colinas de Arigna.
arigna-mining-experience.en_description: A guided tour of a real coal mine led by former miners, in the Arigna hills.

strokestown-park-famine-museum.pt_source: Mansão georgiana com o Museu Nacional da Grande Fome e jardins murados restaurados.
strokestown-park-famine-museum.en_description: A Georgian mansion with the National Famine Museum and restored walled gardens.

boyle-abbey.pt_source: Abadia cisterciense do século XII com claustro impressionante, no coração de Boyle.
boyle-abbey.en_description: A 12th-century Cistercian abbey with an impressive cloister, in the heart of Boyle.

rathcroghan.pt_source: Capital real antiga de Connacht e porta de entrada para o outro mundo na mitologia irlandesa.
rathcroghan.en_description: The ancient royal capital of Connacht and gateway to the Otherworld in Irish mythology.

lough-ree.pt_source: Grande lago do rio Shannon com ilhas, pesca, passeios de barco e praias fluviais.
lough-ree.en_description: A great lake on the River Shannon with islands, fishing, boat trips and riverside beaches.

newcastle-wood.pt_source: Floresta de coníferas e folhosas com trilhas tranquilas perto de Ballymahon.
newcastle-wood.en_description: A forest of conifers and broadleaves with peaceful trails near Ballymahon.

royal-canal-greenway.pt_source: Greenway de 130 km ao longo do Royal Canal, de Dublin a Cloondara — o trecho final fica em Longford.
royal-canal-greenway.en_description: A 130 km greenway along the Royal Canal, from Dublin to Cloondara — the final stretch is in Longford.

granard-motte-bailey.pt_source: Motte normanda do século XII sobre morro antigo, com estátua de Santa Kitirine e vistas amplas.
granard-motte-bailey.en_description: A 12th-century Norman motte on an ancient hill, with a St Kitirine statue and wide views.

ardagh-heritage-village.pt_source: Vila vencedora de prêmios de conservação, com verde central pitoresco e centro de interpretação.
ardagh-heritage-village.en_description: An award-winning heritage village, with a picturesque village green and an interpretive centre.

corlea-trackway.pt_source: Centro que protege uma estrada de carvalho de 2.000 anos construída sobre a turfeira, única na Europa.
corlea-trackway.en_description: A centre protecting a 2,000-year-old oak road built across the bog, the only one of its kind in Europe.

glendeer-pet-farm.pt_source: Fazenda de animais aberta ao público com cabras, cordeiros, aves e playground coberto.
glendeer-pet-farm.en_description: An animal farm open to visitors, with goats, lambs, birds and an indoor playground.

mullaghmeen-forest.pt_source: Grande floresta de folhosas plantadas, com trilhas e vista para o Lough Derravaragh.
mullaghmeen-forest.en_description: A large planted broadleaf forest, with trails and views over Lough Derravaragh.

kilbeggan-distillery.pt_source: Destilaria licenciada mais antiga do mundo (1757), com moinho a vapor funcionando e degustações.
kilbeggan-distillery.en_description: The world's oldest licensed distillery (1757), with a working steam mill and tastings.

athlone-castle.pt_source: Castelo normando do século XII no rio Shannon, com museu interativo sobre o cerco de Athlone.
athlone-castle.en_description: A 12th-century Norman castle on the River Shannon, with an interactive museum about the Siege of Athlone.

belvedere-house-gardens.pt_source: Casa de campo do século XVIII com jardins, folly "Jealous Wall" e eventos familiares o ano inteiro.
belvedere-house-gardens.en_description: An 18th-century country house with gardens, the "Jealous Wall" folly and family events all year round.

tullamore-dew-experience.pt_source: Centro de visitantes do whisky Tullamore D.E.W. num armazém do século XIX, com degustações guiadas.
tullamore-dew-experience.en_description: The Tullamore D.E.W. whiskey visitor centre in a 19th-century warehouse, with guided tastings.

charleville-forest-castle.pt_source: Castelo neogótico do século XIX cercado por floresta antiga de carvalhos, com tours e eventos.
charleville-forest-castle.en_description: A 19th-century neo-Gothic castle surrounded by ancient oak woodland, with tours and events.

lough-boora-discovery-park.pt_source: Parque de turfeiras regeneradas com esculturas ao ar livre, trilhas de caminhada e ciclismo e aves raras.
lough-boora-discovery-park.en_description: A park of regenerated boglands with outdoor sculptures, walking and cycling trails and rare birds.

birr-castle-demesne.pt_source: Propriedade científica dos Parsons com jardins premiados, o telescópio gigante do século XIX e centro de ciência.
birr-castle-demesne.en_description: The Parsons' scientific estate with award-winning gardens, the giant 19th-century telescope and a science centre.

clonmacnoise.pt_source: Um dos mosteiros mais importantes da Europa medieval, às margens do rio Shannon, com torres redondas e alta cruzes.
clonmacnoise.en_description: One of medieval Europe's most important monasteries, on the banks of the River Shannon, with round towers and high crosses.

slieve-bloom-mountains.pt_source: Montanhas de turfeira e floresta entre Laois e Offaly, com trilhas, cachoeiras e mirantes panorâmicos.
slieve-bloom-mountains.en_description: Mountains of bogland and forest between Laois and Offaly, with trails, waterfalls and panoramic viewpoints.

abbeyleix-heritage-house.pt_source: Centro de patrimônio que conta a história planejada da vila georgiana de Abbeyleix e do tapete local.
abbeyleix-heritage-house.en_description: A heritage centre telling the story of planned Georgian Abbeyleix and of the local carpet industry.

timahoe-round-tower.pt_source: Torre redonda do século XII considerada uma das mais belas da Irlanda, com portal ricamente decorado.
timahoe-round-tower.en_description: A 12th-century round tower considered one of Ireland's most beautiful, with a richly decorated doorway.

heywood-gardens.pt_source: Jardins formais dos séculos XVIII/XIX com terraços, lago e o famoso "jardim secreto" circular.
heywood-gardens.en_description: Formal 18th/19th-century gardens with terraces, a lake and the famous circular "secret garden".

emo-court.pt_source: Mansão neoclássica do século XVIII com jardins e lago desenhados por Capability Brown; entrada gratuita.
emo-court.en_description: An 18th-century neoclassical mansion with gardens and a lake designed by Capability Brown; free entry.

rock-of-dunamase.pt_source: Fortaleza normanda em ruínas sobre afloramento rochoso, com vistas de 360° pelo interior de Laois.
rock-of-dunamase.en_description: A ruined Norman fortress on a rocky outcrop, with 360° views across the Laois countryside.

banna-strand.pt_source: Praia extensa de areia dourada ao norte de Tralee, com dunas e águas ideais para surf e banho.
banna-strand.en_description: A long beach of golden sand north of Tralee, with dunes and waters ideal for surfing and swimming.

muckross-abbey.pt_source: Abadia franciscana do século XV com claustro e um enorme teixo central, no coração do parque nacional.
muckross-abbey.en_description: A 15th-century Franciscan abbey with a cloister and a huge central yew tree, in the heart of the national park.

gallarus-oratory.pt_source: Oratório cristão primitivo em pedra seca, com mais de 1.200 anos, em forma de casco de barco invertido.
gallarus-oratory.en_description: An early Christian dry-stone oratory, over 1,200 years old, shaped like an upturned boat.

derrynane-house.pt_source: Casa de Daniel O'Connell, o Libertador, dentro de um parque costeiro com praia e jardins subtropicais.
derrynane-house.en_description: The house of Daniel O'Connell, the Liberator, within a coastal park with a beach and subtropical gardens.

kerry-cliffs.pt_source: Falésias de mais de 300 metros com vista para Skellig Michael, no Anel de Skellig.
kerry-cliffs.en_description: Cliffs over 300 metres high with views of Skellig Michael, on the Skellig Ring.

valentia-island.pt_source: Ilha conectada por ponte e ferry, com pegadas de dinossauro, jardins subtropicais e o farol de Cromwell Point.
valentia-island.en_description: An island linked by bridge and ferry, with dinosaur footprints, subtropical gardens and the Cromwell Point lighthouse.

skellig-michael.pt_source: Patrimônio Mundial da UNESCO: mosteiro do século VI no topo de ilha rochosa no Atlântico, cenário de Star Wars.
skellig-michael.en_description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site: a 6th-century monastery atop a rocky island in the Atlantic, a Star Wars filming location.

doneraile-park.pt_source: Parque paisagístico do século XVIII com cervos, trilhas e playground, entrada gratuita.
doneraile-park.en_description: An 18th-century landscaped park with deer, trails and a playground — free entry.

spike-island-cork.pt_source: Ilha-fortaleza no porto de Cork, já a maior prisão do mundo, hoje museu premiado acessível por ferry.
spike-island-cork.en_description: A fortress island in Cork harbour, once the world's largest prison, today an award-winning museum reached by ferry.

garnish-island.pt_source: Ilha-jardim na baía de Glengarriff, famosa pelos jardins italianos, torre martelo e focas no trajeto de barco.
garnish-island.en_description: A garden island in Glengarriff harbour, famous for its Italian gardens, Martello tower and the seals seen on the boat trip.

blackrock-castle-observatory.pt_source: Castelo do século XVI transformado em observatório de ciências astronômicas às margens do rio Lee.
blackrock-castle-observatory.en_description: A 16th-century castle turned astronomical science observatory on the banks of the River Lee.

cork-city-gaol.pt_source: Antiga prisão vitoriana com figuras de cera e audioguia sobre dois séculos de vida carcerária.
cork-city-gaol.en_description: A former Victorian prison with wax figures and an audio guide covering two centuries of prison life.

english-market-cork.pt_source: Mercado coberto histórico do século XVIII, templo da gastronomia de Cork com bancas de peixe, queijos e quitandas.
english-market-cork.en_description: A historic 18th-century covered market, a temple of Cork gastronomy with stalls of fish, cheeses and baked goods.

vandeleur-walled-garden.pt_source: Jardim murado do século XIX restaurado, com estufa vitoriana e café, no oeste de Clare.
vandeleur-walled-garden.en_description: A restored 19th-century walled garden, with a Victorian glasshouse and a café, in west Clare.

craggaunowen.pt_source: Parque de história viva que recria a Irlanda pré-histórica e medieval, com crannóg e casa fortificada.
craggaunowen.en_description: A living-history park recreating prehistoric and medieval Ireland, with a crannóg and a fortified house.

spanish-point-beach.pt_source: Baía de areia com águas calmas e história ligada à Armada Espanhola, popular para famílias e surf.
spanish-point-beach.en_description: A sandy bay with calm waters and history linked to the Spanish Armada, popular with families and surfers.

holy-island-inis-cealtra.pt_source: Ilha sagrada no Lough Derg com mosteiro do século VII, células de pedra e cruzes antigas.
holy-island-inis-cealtra.en_description: A holy island on Lough Derg with a 7th-century monastery, stone cells and ancient crosses.

scattery-island.pt_source: Ilha monástica no estuário do Shannon, com torre redonda, ruínas de igrejas e colônia de focas.
scattery-island.en_description: A monastic island in the Shannon estuary, with a round tower, church ruins and a seal colony.

ennis-friary.pt_source: Convento franciscano do século XIII com esculturas medievais notáveis, no centro de Ennis.
ennis-friary.en_description: A 13th-century Franciscan friary with notable medieval carvings, in the centre of Ennis.

thoor-ballylee.pt_source: Torre normanda do século XIV onde viveu o poeta W.B. Yeats, chamada por ele de "o lugar mais bonito do mundo".
thoor-ballylee.en_description: A 14th-century Norman tower where the poet W.B. Yeats lived, called by him "the most beautiful place on earth".

portumna-castle-gardens.pt_source: Mansão fortificada do século XVII às margens do Lough Derg, com jardins restaurados e parque florestal.
portumna-castle-gardens.en_description: A 17th-century fortified mansion on the shores of Lough Derg, with restored gardens and a forest park.

coole-park.pt_source: Reserva natural e antiga propriedade de Lady Gregory, coração do Renascimento Literário irlandês.
coole-park.en_description: A nature reserve and former Lady Gregory estate, heart of the Irish Literary Revival.

brigits-garden.pt_source: Jardins inspirados nas festas celtas, com jardim solar, floresta antiga e playground natural.
brigits-garden.en_description: Gardens inspired by the Celtic festivals, with a sun garden, ancient woodland and a natural playground.

galway-city-museum.pt_source: Museu moderno sobre a história de Galway, do período medieval à cultura das Ilhas Aran.
galway-city-museum.en_description: A modern museum on the history of Galway, from the medieval period to the culture of the Aran Islands.

spanish-arch-long-walk.pt_source: Arco do século XVI à beira do rio Corrib e as coloridas casas do Long Walk, cartão-postal de Galway.
spanish-arch-long-walk.en_description: A 16th-century arch on the River Corrib and the colourful houses of the Long Walk, a Galway postcard view.

dowth.pt_source: Terceiro grande túmulo de passagem do Brú na Bóinne, com 5.000 anos, aberto a visitas guiadas.
dowth.en_description: The third great passage tomb of Brú na Bóinne, 5,000 years old, open to guided visits.

sonairte-ecology-centre.pt_source: Centro de ecologia e horta orgânica numa fazenda histórica perto do mar, com trilhas e loja vegetariana.
sonairte-ecology-centre.en_description: An ecology centre and organic garden on a historic farm near the sea, with trails and a vegetarian café.

kells-historic-town.pt_source: Vila monástica histórica, antiga casa do Livro de Kells, com alta cruzes e torre redonda.
kells-historic-town.en_description: A historic monastic town, former home of the Book of Kells, with high crosses and a round tower.

bective-abbey.pt_source: Ruínas de abadia cisterciense do século XII às margens do rio Boyne, cenário do filme Braveheart.
bective-abbey.en_description: Ruins of a 12th-century Cistercian abbey on the banks of the River Boyne, a filming location for Braveheart.

emerald-park.pt_source: Parque temático e zoológico (antigo Tayto Park) com montanhas-russas, zoo e atrações para toda a família.
emerald-park.en_description: A theme park and zoo (formerly Tayto Park) with roller coasters, a zoo and attractions for the whole family.

wicklow-way.pt_source: A trilha de longa distância mais antiga da Irlanda: 131 km pelas montanhas de Wicklow, de Dublin a Clonegal.
wicklow-way.en_description: Ireland's oldest long-distance trail: 131 km through the Wicklow Mountains, from Dublin to Clonegal.

mount-usher-gardens.pt_source: Jardins românticos às margens do rio Vartry, com plantas de todo o mundo e estilo de jardim selvagem.
mount-usher-gardens.en_description: Romantic gardens on the banks of the River Vartry, with plants from all over the world and a wild-garden style.

killruddery-house-gardens.pt_source: Mansão do século XVII ainda habitada, com jardins formais, orangerie e mercado de produtores aos sábados.
killruddery-house-gardens.en_description: A 17th-century mansion still lived in, with formal gardens, an orangery and a farmers' market on Saturdays.

brittas-bay-beach.pt_source: Uma das melhores praias da costa leste, com 4 km de areia dourada e dunas protegidas.
brittas-bay-beach.en_description: One of the east coast's finest beaches, with 4 km of golden sand and protected dunes.

wicklow-historic-gaol.pt_source: Prisão histórica do século XVIII transformada em museu interativo sobre dois séculos de história sombria.
wicklow-historic-gaol.en_description: An 18th-century prison turned interactive museum on two centuries of dark history.

russborough-house.pt_source: Mansão palladiana do século XVIII com interior ornamentado, labirinto e vista para as montanhas de Wicklow.
russborough-house.en_description: An 18th-century Palladian mansion with an ornate interior, a maze and views of the Wicklow Mountains.

portmarnock-beach.pt_source: Longa praia de areia ao norte de Dublin, popular para caminhadas, banhos e esportes aquáticos.
portmarnock-beach.en_description: A long sandy beach north of Dublin, popular for walks, swimming and water sports.

dun-laoghaire-east-pier.pt_source: Calçadão marítimo de 1,3 km com vistas da baía de Dublin, ideal para caminhadas à beira-mar.
dun-laoghaire-east-pier.en_description: A 1.3 km seafront promenade with views of Dublin Bay, ideal for a walk by the sea.

glasnevin-cemetery-museum.pt_source: Cemitério histórico onde repousam os grandes nomes da independência irlandesa, com museu e visitas guiadas.
glasnevin-cemetery-museum.en_description: A historic cemetery where the great names of Irish independence rest, with a museum and guided tours.

national-botanic-gardens-dublin.pt_source: Jardins botânicos nacionais com estufas vitorianas, mais de 15 mil espécies de plantas e entrada gratuita.
national-botanic-gardens-dublin.en_description: The national botanic gardens with Victorian glasshouses, more than 15,000 plant species and free entry.

epic-irish-emigration-museum.pt_source: Museu interativo premiado que conta a história dos 10 milhões de irlandeses que emigraram pelo mundo.
epic-irish-emigration-museum.en_description: An award-winning interactive museum telling the story of the 10 million Irish who emigrated around the world.

national-museum-archaeology.pt_source: Museu nacional com tesouros da Irlanda antiga: artefatos vikings, ouro da Idade do Bronze e corpos de pântano.
national-museum-archaeology.en_description: The national museum with treasures of ancient Ireland: Viking artefacts, Bronze Age gold and bog bodies.

inch-beach.pt_source: Longa praia de areia na península de Dingle, popular para surf e caminhadas.
inch-beach.en_description: A long sandy beach on the Dingle Peninsula, popular for surfing and walks.

dingle-peninsula.pt_source: Península gaélica com praias selvagens, Slea Head e o centro urbano de Dingle.
dingle-peninsula.en_description: A Gaelic-speaking peninsula with wild beaches, Slea Head and the town of Dingle.

ring-of-kerry.pt_source: Rota cênica circular de 179 km pela península de Iveragh, com vistas costeiras espetaculares.
ring-of-kerry.en_description: A 179 km scenic circular route around the Iveragh Peninsula, with spectacular coastal views.

gap-of-dunloe.pt_source: Desfiladeiro glaciar entre montanhas, percorrido por carruagens e trilhas.
gap-of-dunloe.en_description: A glacial gorge between mountains, explored by horse-drawn carriages and on foot.

torc-waterfall.pt_source: Cascata de 20 metros rodeada de floresta, nas encostas do Monte Torc.
torc-waterfall.en_description: A 20-metre waterfall surrounded by woodland, on the slopes of Mount Torc.

ross-castle.pt_source: Castelo do século XV às margens do Lago de Leane, com passeios de barco.
ross-castle.en_description: A 15th-century castle on the shores of Lough Leane, with boat trips.

muckross-house.pt_source: Mansão vitoriana no coração do parque, com jardins e quintas tradicionais.
muckross-house.en_description: A Victorian mansion in the heart of the park, with gardens and traditional farms.

killarney-national-park.pt_source: Primeiro parque nacional da Irlanda, com lagos, montanhas e o castelo de Ross.
killarney-national-park.en_description: Ireland's first national park, with lakes, mountains and Ross Castle.

mizen-head.pt_source: Ponto mais a sudoeste da Irlanda, com ponte sobre o desfiladeiro, sinal marítimo e vistas do Atlântico.
mizen-head.en_description: Ireland's most south-westerly point, with a bridge over the gorge, a maritime signal station and Atlantic views.

charles-fort.pt_source: Forte em estrela do século XVII na entrada do porto de Kinsale.
charles-fort.en_description: A 17th-century star fort at the entrance to Kinsale harbour.

kinsale.pt_source: Vila costeira pitoresca com ruas coloridas, gastronomia premiada e uma história marítima rica.
kinsale.en_description: A picturesque coastal town with colourful streets, award-winning food and a rich maritime history.

jameson-distillery-midleton.pt_source: Destilaria histórica onde se produz o whisky Jameson, com visitas guiadas e degustações.
jameson-distillery-midleton.en_description: A historic distillery where Jameson whiskey is produced, with guided tours and tastings.

fota-wildlife-park.pt_source: Parque de vida selvagem na ilha de Fota, com animais em recintos abertos e um castelo.
fota-wildlife-park.en_description: A wildlife park on Fota Island, with animals in open enclosures and a castle.

titanic-experience-cobh.pt_source: Museu interativo que recria a história do Titanic e da sua ligação com Cobh.
titanic-experience-cobh.en_description: An interactive museum recreating the story of the Titanic and its link with Cobh.

cobh.pt_source: Cidade portuária histórica, última paragem do Titanic e porto de partida de milhões de emigrantes.
cobh.en_description: A historic port town, the Titanic's last port of call and the departure point of millions of emigrants.

blarney-castle.pt_source: Castelo medieval famoso pela Pedra de Blarney, cujo beijo concede "o dom da eloquência".
blarney-castle.en_description: A medieval castle famous for the Blarney Stone, whose kiss grants "the gift of eloquence".

kilkee-cliffs.pt_source: Passarela costeira ao longo de falésias com formações rochosas características.
kilkee-cliffs.en_description: A coastal walkway along cliffs with distinctive rock formations.

lahinch-beach.pt_source: Praia de areia popular para surf e banhos de mar na costa oeste da Irlanda.
lahinch-beach.en_description: A sandy beach popular for surfing and sea swimming on Ireland's west coast.

loop-head.pt_source: Península com falésias e um farol clássico na entrada do estuário do Shannon.
loop-head.en_description: A peninsula with cliffs and a classic lighthouse at the mouth of the Shannon estuary.

doolin-cave.pt_source: Caverna com um dos maiores estalactites pendentes do mundo.
doolin-cave.en_description: A cave with one of the largest free-hanging stalactites in the world.

aillwee-caves.pt_source: Sistema de cavernas no Burren com formações de pedra e uma cascata subterrânea.
aillwee-caves.en_description: A cave system in the Burren with stone formations and an underground waterfall.

bunratty-castle-folk-park.pt_source: Castelo do século XV restaurado com um parque folclórico que recria a vida rural irlandesa.
bunratty-castle-folk-park.en_description: A restored 15th-century castle with a folk park recreating rural Irish life.

burren-national-park.pt_source: Paisagem cárstica única de calcário com flora rara e trilhas no Condado de Clare.
burren-national-park.en_description: A unique limestone karst landscape with rare flora and trails in County Clare.

cliffs-of-moher.pt_source: Falésias de 214 metros sobre o Oceano Atlântico, uma das atrações naturais mais famosas da Irlanda.
cliffs-of-moher.en_description: Cliffs 214 metres above the Atlantic Ocean, one of Ireland's most famous natural attractions.

galway-atlantaquaria.pt_source: Aquário nacional da Irlanda, em Salthill, com vida marinha local e tanques interativos.
galway-atlantaquaria.en_description: Ireland's national aquarium, in Salthill, with local marine life and interactive tanks.

diamond-hill.pt_source: Trilha em Connemara com vistas panorâmicas da baía de Ballynakill e das Twelve Bens.
diamond-hill.en_description: A trail in Connemara with panoramic views of Ballynakill Bay and the Twelve Bens.

dun-aonghasa.pt_source: Forte de pedra pré-histórico na borda de um penhasco de 100 m na ilha de Inishmore.
dun-aonghasa.en_description: A prehistoric stone fort on the edge of a 100 m cliff on the island of Inishmore.

aran-islands.pt_source: Ilhas gaélicas na foz da Baía de Galway, famosas pelas fortalezas de pedra e cultura tradicional.
aran-islands.en_description: Gaelic islands at the mouth of Galway Bay, famous for their stone forts and traditional culture.

sky-road.pt_source: Rota costeira cênica ao redor da península de Kingstown, com vistas de Clifden e da baía.
sky-road.en_description: A scenic coastal route around the Kingstown peninsula, with views of Clifden and the bay.

salthill.pt_source: Promenade litorânea de Galway, com praia, piscina de mar e vista para a baía.
salthill.en_description: Galway's seaside promenade, with a beach, a sea pool and views over the bay.

connemara-national-park.pt_source: Parque nacional de montanhas, turfeiras e pôneis selvagens, com trilhas até o Diamond Hill.
connemara-national-park.en_description: A national park of mountains, bogs and wild ponies, with trails up Diamond Hill.

kylemore-abbey.pt_source: Mosteiro e castelo do século XIX num cenário lacustre deslumbrante em Connemara.
kylemore-abbey.en_description: A 19th-century abbey and castle in a stunning lakeside setting in Connemara.

battle-of-the-boyne-visitor-centre.pt_source: Centro de visitantes que conta a história da Batalha do Boyne de 1690, na casa de Oldbridge.
battle-of-the-boyne-visitor-centre.pt_title: Battle of the Boyne Visitor Centre
battle-of-the-boyne-visitor-centre.en_description: A visitor centre telling the story of the 1690 Battle of the Boyne, at Oldbridge House.

loughcrew.pt_source: Conjunto de túmulos de passagem neolíticos nas colinas de Loughcrew, com arte rupestre.
loughcrew.en_description: A cluster of Neolithic passage tombs in the Loughcrew hills, with rock art.

slane-castle.pt_source: Castelo histórico às margens do rio Boyne, conhecido pelos seus concertos e destilaria.
slane-castle.en_description: A historic castle on the banks of the River Boyne, known for its concerts and distillery.

trim-castle.pt_source: O maior castelo anglo-normando da Irlanda, famoso por ter sido locação do filme "Braveheart".
trim-castle.en_description: Ireland's largest Anglo-Norman castle, famous as a filming location for "Braveheart".

hill-of-tara.pt_source: Antiga sede dos Reis Supremos da Irlanda, com monumentos e vistas panorâmicas.
hill-of-tara.en_description: The ancient seat of the High Kings of Ireland, with monuments and panoramic views.

knowth.pt_source: Grande túmulo de passagem neolítico com a maior coleção de arte megalítica da Europa ocidental.
knowth.en_description: A great Neolithic passage tomb with the largest collection of megalithic art in western Europe.

newgrange.pt_source: Túmulo de passagem neolítico com mais de 5.000 anos, mais antigo que Stonehenge e as pirâmides.
newgrange.en_description: A Neolithic passage tomb over 5,000 years old, older than Stonehenge and the pyramids.

avondale-forest-park.pt_source: Parque florestal com trilhas, passeios de copa de árvores e história ligada a Charles Stewart Parnell.
avondale-forest-park.en_description: A forest park with trails, treetop walks and history linked to Charles Stewart Parnell.

sally-gap.pt_source: Passo de montanha cênico nas montanhas de Wicklow, rodeado de turfeiras e berços dos rios Liffey e Dargle.
sally-gap.en_description: A scenic mountain pass in the Wicklow Mountains, surrounded by bogs where the rivers Liffey and Dargle rise.

great-sugar-loaf.pt_source: Pico de montanha em forma de cúpula com vistas panorâmicas das montanhas de Wicklow e da costa.
great-sugar-loaf.en_description: A dome-shaped mountain peak with panoramic views of the Wicklow Mountains and the coast.

bray-head.pt_source: Trilha costeira com uma grande cruz no topo e vistas da baía de Bray e das montanhas de Wicklow.
bray-head.en_description: A coastal trail with a large cross at the summit and views of Bray Bay and the Wicklow Mountains.

powerscourt-waterfall.pt_source: A cachoeira mais alta da Irlanda, com 121 metros, cercada por trilhas na floresta.
powerscourt-waterfall.en_description: Ireland's highest waterfall, at 121 metres, surrounded by forest trails.

powerscourt-estate.pt_source: Mansão histórica com jardins premiados e o Terraço da Cachoeira; também há um centro de compras e café.
powerscourt-estate.en_description: A historic mansion with award-winning gardens and the Waterfall Terrace; there is also a shopping centre and café.

glendalough.pt_source: Assentamento monástico do século VI num vale glacial com lagos e trilhas.
glendalough.en_description: A 6th-century monastic settlement in a glacial valley with lakes and trails.

wicklow-mountains-national-park.pt_source: Parque nacional de montanhas, lagos e vales glaciais, conhecido como o "Jardim da Irlanda".
wicklow-mountains-national-park.en_description: A national park of mountains, lakes and glacial valleys — known as the "Garden of Ireland".

malahide-castle-gardens.pt_source: Castelo de 800 anos com jardins exuberantes, localizado na vila litorânea de Malahide.
malahide-castle-gardens.en_description: An 800-year-old castle with lush gardens, located in the coastal village of Malahide.

howth-cliff-walk.pt_source: Trilha costeira espetacular ao redor da península de Howth, com vistas do mar da Irlanda.
howth-cliff-walk.en_description: A spectacular coastal trail around the Howth Peninsula, with views of the Irish Sea.

dublin-zoo.pt_source: Zoológico no Phoenix Park com animais de todo o mundo e programas de conservação.
dublin-zoo.en_description: A zoo in Phoenix Park with animals from around the world and conservation programmes.

phoenix-park.pt_source: Um dos maiores parques urbanos fechados da Europa, lar de veados selvagens, a residência presidencial e o Dublin Zoo.
phoenix-park.en_description: One of Europe's largest enclosed city parks, home to wild deer, the presidential residence and Dublin Zoo.

guinness-storehouse.pt_source: A famosa fábrica e museu da cerveja Guinness, com o bar panorâmico Gravity no topo.
guinness-storehouse.en_description: The famous Guinness brewery and museum, with the panoramic Gravity Bar at the top.

kilmainham-gaol.pt_source: Prisão histórica que desempenhou papel central na luta pela independência irlandesa. Museu imperdível.
kilmainham-gaol.en_description: A historic prison that played a central role in the struggle for Irish independence. An unmissable museum.

dublin-castle.pt_source: Castelo histórico no coração de Dublin, sede do governo britânico na Irlanda por séculos e agora um complexo de museus e salões de estado.
dublin-castle.en_description: A historic castle in the heart of Dublin, seat of the British government in Ireland for centuries and now a complex of museums and state halls.

trinity-college-book-of-kells.pt_source: A icônica universidade irlandesa e o famoso Livro de Kells, um dos mais importantes manuscritos medievais do mundo.
trinity-college-book-of-kells.en_description: Ireland's iconic university and the famous Book of Kells, one of the most important medieval manuscripts in the world.

fetch-courses.pt_source: Encontre cursos de formação e educação continuada em toda a Irlanda, incluindo aprendizagens, traineeships, cursos PLC, educação de adultos e outras oportunidades de FET.
fetch-courses.en_description: Find training and continuing education courses throughout Ireland, including apprenticeships, traineeships, PLC courses, adult education and other FET opportunities.

qualifax.pt_source: A base de dados nacional da Irlanda para cursos e orientação ao estudante, ajudando estudantes, candidatos a emprego e adultos a explorar opções de educação e formação.
qualifax.en_description: Ireland's national database for courses and student guidance, helping students, jobseekers and adults explore education and training options.

springboard-plus.pt_source: Descubra cursos superiores subsidiados criados para ajudar as pessoas a requalificar, aprimorar competências e desenvolver novas oportunidades de carreira.
springboard-plus.en_description: Discover subsidised further education courses designed to help people requalify, build skills and develop new career opportunities.

skillnet-ireland.pt_source: Descubra oportunidades de formação e requalificação desenhadas em torno das necessidades de empresas, colaboradores e setores da indústria em toda a Irlanda.
skillnet-ireland.en_description: Discover training and reskilling opportunities designed around the needs of companies, employees and industry sectors throughout Ireland.

solas-ecollege.pt_source: Aprendizagem online e desenvolvimento de competências da SOLAS, incluindo competências digitais, TI, gestão de projetos, negócios e outras áreas.
solas-ecollege.en_description: SOLAS online learning and skills development, including digital skills, IT, project management, business and other areas.

local-enterprise-office.pt_source: Programas de formação e cursos de negócios para quem está a iniciar, desenvolver ou fazer crescer um negócio na Irlanda.
local-enterprise-office.en_description: Training programmes and business courses for those starting, developing or growing a business in Ireland.

courses-ie.pt_source: Explore milhares de cursos de faculdades, universidades, fornecedores de formação e educadores independentes em toda a Irlanda.
courses-ie.en_description: Explore thousands of courses from colleges, universities, training providers and independent educators throughout Ireland.

etbi.pt_source: Encontre oportunidades de educação e formação oferecidas através da rede de Education and Training Boards na Irlanda.
etbi.en_description: Find education and training opportunities offered through the network of Education and Training Boards in Ireland.

apprenticeship-ie.pt_source: Portal nacional para encontrar apprenticeships na Irlanda, combinando formação prática no trabalho com formação fora do trabalho e oportunidades em diversas áreas profissionais.
apprenticeship-ie.en_description: National portal to find apprenticeships in Ireland, combining on-the-job training with off-the-job training and opportunities across many occupational areas.

microcreds.pt_source: Explore micro-credenciais curtas, flexíveis e acreditadas por universidades irlandesas, com opções em áreas como negócios, tecnologia, educação, saúde e outras áreas profissionais.
microcreds.en_description: Explore short, flexible micro-credentials awarded by Irish universities, with options in areas such as business, technology, education, health and other professional fields.
